observations.body: The naming of Jezreel joins remembered bloodshed with an announced end to the kingdom of the house of Israel.

payload.posture: Read Hosea 1:2–7 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the naming of Jezreel joins remembered bloodshed with an announced end to the kingdom of the house of Israel. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
